title: How to add a Northern Lights effect?

posts.author: DeterminedKid1000
posts.body:
VisuStella has this beautiful, but very frustrating plugin for MZ that adds the northern lights as a weather effect, but it’s not compatible for MV. I do have MZ, but I use MV because I have hundreds of dollars worth of plugins that I bought years ago before MZ came out, and I don’t know if the same plugins exist for MZ. I’d have to probably spend a lot of money to replace them if they do. (And again, I’m not sure if there’s replacements for all of them and some plugins are essential for my game.)
Does anyone know an alternative? Or a way to port it to MV? Please let me know. The Northern Lights is actually important for a scene in my game that will happen later, and VisuStella’s plugin is unfortunately the only way I know how to add it.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
I believe he is referring to this, the "Show Picture" command allows you to display images on the screen:
To create a sequence of animations, you can do it like this:
Code:
◆Show Picture：#1, Lights, Center (0,0), (100%,100%), 255, Normal
◆Wait：15 frames
◆Show Picture：#1, Lights, Center (0,0), (100%,100%), 255, Normal
◆Wait：15 frames
◆Show Picture：#1, Lights, Center (0,0), (100%,100%), 255, Normal
◆Wait：15 frames
◆Show Picture：#1, Lights, Center (0,0), (100%,100%), 255, Normal
◆Wait：15 frames
◆Show Picture：#1, Lights, Center (0,0), (100%,100%), 255, Normal
◆Wait：15 frames
◆Show Picture：#1, Lights, Center (0,0), (100%,100%), 255, Normal
◆Wait：15 frames
In the case of an aurora borealis, it would be necessary to have about three images, one on top of the other, moving from one side of the screen to the other:
Code:
◆Show Picture：#1, Lights, Center (1224,0), (100%,100%), 255, Normal
◆Show Picture：#2, Lights, Center (408,0), (100%,100%), 255, Normal
◆Move Picture：#1, Center (408,0), (100%,100%), 255, Normal, 60 frames
◆Move Picture：#2, Center (1224,0), (100%,100%), 255, Normal, 60 frames(Wait)
◆Move Picture：#1, Center (1224,0), (100%,100%), 255, Normal, 60 frames
◆Move Picture：#2, Center (408,0), (100%,100%), 255, Normal, 60 frames (Wait)
Note that only the second "Move Picture" has the "WAIT" parameter enabled.

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body:
I think it might make more sense to use parallax rather than picture to display something like this? The key difference in RPGMaker is that a picture shows on top of the map, but a parallax shows underneath the map – so it's not possible for it to "cover the whole screen" unless the map is entirely blank.
You could maybe get a wavering effect by making the parallax scroll horizontally… or you could use event commands to cycle through several parallax images, just like Dev With Coffee's picture examples.
